domain_description: Processes outage logs, postmortems, and runbook PDFs against known problem tickets to generate prioritized remediation tasks.
agent_role: Principal Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) & Incident Commander
story_template: As an <SRE/service owner>, I need to <remediation action>, so that <MTTR/reliability SLA impact>

priority_rubric.P0 - Critical: Active customer-facing SEV-1 impact or recurring cascading failure vector.
priority_rubric.P1 - High: Prevents repeat outage or closes a blind spot in production alerting within current sprint.
priority_rubric.P2 - Medium: Reduces toil or improves secondary service resilience.
priority_rubric.P3 - Low: Long-term architectural cleanup or documentation refinement.

custom_constraints: Map every remediation action against existing problem tickets to avoid duplicate engineering work.
Ensure every acceptance criterion includes a concrete verification metric (e.g., p99 latency, error budget, alert threshold).
